item.title: Your Business Number Is Already "Spam Risk". New Regulation Won't Fix That
item.description: Photo source: Interactive Powers Your Business Number Is Already “Spam Risk”. New Regulation Won’t Fix That We did the math: 8 out of 10 incoming calls most people receive today are flagged “Spam Risk”. Out of pure caution, almost nobody answers a number they don’t recognize anymore — and that includes the number your contact center is calling from. That’s already the reality facing voice as an outbound sales channel.
